contracts: (Both attempted operations are rejected and historical state before equals historical state after.) AND (Fixture comparison proves only rename/delete varies, then records the rejection verification.)
selector_intents: A fixture that changes any non-target input alongside rename/delete must fail the verification guard for lack of isolation.
A fixture where the governed write path allows rename or delete of a historical target must fail because historical state changes.
A verification run without a complete before/after historical-state snapshot must fail closed as unverifiable.
Verification evidence missing the controlled-input comparison must fail artifact validation.
